selection: Archived fixed-policy lift attempts with only mass and equal static/dynamic cube friction varying. Restrict both properties to the checkpoint's marginal ranges.

definitions.contact_steps: Issued commands with a physics tick during which either finger exerted a pair force above 0.05 N on the cube.
definitions.lifted: First archived state with simultaneous grasp and cube bottom clearance of at least 0.02 m above the support. A first state index of -1 means no lift.
definitions.slip: Recorded after or during a lift when relative finger/tool-to-cube motion during a continuous grasp meets 5 mm translation or 0.15 rad rotation between state samples.
definitions.final_task_success: The task's end-of-trial goal and hold criterion.
